summary: EQT Infrastructure Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting a routine unregistered sale of its own shares in a continuous private offering, raising $84.77 million as of August 1, 2026 at per-class transaction net asset values. The filing also provides the July 31, 2026 NAV per share for each class. This is a standard ongoing capital raise with no event-driven special situation, no merger, tender, or strategic change. The item 3.02 disclosure is routine; item 8.01 is a periodic NAV update. No special-situation category applies; the registrant is solely the issuer of equity securities.
